Add edge-new-01

The device needs this block in its configuration to join the hub; on the device, ze init --managed asks for the same values. The secret is never shown: type the one set on the hub.

client edge-new-01
plugin {
    hub {
        client edge-new-01 {
            host HUB-ADDRESS;
            port HUB-CLIENT-PORT;
            secret "the secret set for edge-new-01 on the hub";
        }
    }
}
